The PKGBUILD contains no dangerous top-level code, uses standard git+https sources with SKIP checksums, and standard build/install commands. data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is an artifact of a tool error. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to complete the second pass review of PKGBUILD due to an HTTP 400 API error.
learnings: Transient API errors during the second pass of a review should not override a successful initial pass if no new files or risks were introduced; the tool should retry or fallback to the initial pass result.
